snippet.title: Wayfarion Intro Trailer
snippet.description:
Wayfarion is a 2D space action roguelite. Chart procedural sectors, fight in real time, fit weapons and drones, and trade loot at starports. A destroyed ship ends the run. Play solo or in online co-op.

Play on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5482330
https://wayfarion.com/
